data: Which of the following components have the same shape as the 'Lexicon' component?

The Lexicon component is represented by a circular shape. In the figure, all the components labeled as 'Rules' are also circular in shape. Therefore, the components that have the same shape as the 'Lexicon' component are the 'S-T1 Rules', 'S-T2 Rules', and 'S-T3 Rules'. These are all circular in shape, just like the 'Lexicon' component.
